_what: The runs that constitute the reported headline. One definition, in one place, because a glob over results/ms-s*.json silently included a degenerate run and kept a superseded number alive in three documents.

variant_runs._what: model.peritumoral_features = true. Reported as suggestive, not established: +0.058 over the headline, 95% CI [-0.008, +0.128], p = 0.086.

superseded.results/ms-s1337.json: Fold 1 stalled, so this run is scored on 122 of 153 patients and reports 0.674 -- the highest of the three seeds and the least complete. Retrained as base-s1337-rerun.json (0.643, no stalled folds, full cohort), which is the canonical seed-1337 run. Kept on disk as the record of what was originally run, and deliberately NOT deleted; excluded from the headline set.

note: Anything that reports the headline must read this file rather than globbing. The glob pattern results/ms-s*.json is no longer a valid definition of the headline set.

headline_kras.note: at chance; exploratory only. Gevaert et al. (Sci Rep 2017) also report no significant KRAS model on this cohort.
